title: Velvety French Shiitake Mushrooms Macaron
description: A keto-friendly French dish featuring shiitake mushrooms in a velvety macaron, cooked to perfection in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot, evoking nostalgic feelings with its nutty flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the almond flour, coconut flour, and granulated sweetener.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the melted butter, eggs, and softened cream cheese.
Add the sliced shiitake mushrooms to the wet ingredients and stir until they are well coated.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir until a smooth batter forms.
Spoon the batter into a ttukbaegi earthenware pot or a macaron mold.
Bake for 20 minutes or until the edges are lightly golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool completely on a wire rack.
Once cooled, carefully remove the macarons from the pot or mold and serve.
